full_page.content:
1935, September
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 34 Sep. 4 V. Kinnell -15 - fits & weak-spells since 4 - lately has been taking 25 - 30 a day .... raised Lutheran - Father once a Cath. Grandma with him this a.m. and Enrolled.
Mrs. Frances Schmidt has husband and two small children, going to T.B. sanitorium To-day ...
Const. Imbo - 48 - hay-fever bad. . . not to sacraments. . . no Easter. Mary
Page 35 Sep. 4 Mary Gens - Hay-fever
4 Maude Mary Vier - 17 - Vanished Aug. 29th - has not been seen or heard of since - a week to-morrow. Enrolled To-night 9:30. From all reports was good, promising girl ... 9th phone call This p.m. "Maude came home following evening Thursday 10th O.K.
5 Robert Wallace - 17 - nerveous condition.
7 Cecelia Thent - 27 - Nerve Trouble
9 James Dan. Sullivan - 14 mo. last February - bronchial pneumonia & em- physema - threatened with Spinal maningitis. Drs. gave him up as hope- less - Enrolled - now perfectly well. Thanks ...
10 Welsh, John W. - 34 - has sort of paralysis. At times can walk fairly well; at other times absolutely helpless; has been doctoring in many places without any success. Has Mother and wife & little child and a little business to fun - candy ..... Wondering at - Enjoyed other- wise and at sight of other peoples'
Page 36 troubles so much worse than his own was doubting if it were right to pray for own relief !!! Wife a convert ... Enrolled To-day $5.00 promises more frequent communion.
Ann McIntyre - 43 - scalp trouble .. ..
Mabel O'Brien - 31 - inward cancer - has two small children & husband - would like to be spared ..
Mr. Larabel + electricuted.
